a.lede: Ledger is reviewing chain-of-custody practices and anti-tamper protections after modified hardware wallets sold through a third party were allegedly fitted with LTE implants that captured recovery phrases and enabled $93 million in crypto theft.
a.title: After a $93 million crypto hardware-wallet supply chain attack, Ledger to review sales and anti-tamper policies

b.lede: Ledger has announced its latest crypto-centric hardware effort, the Android-based Atom, a device that resembles a phone but is instead designed to be used alongside one. b.title: Ledger’s new hardware wallet is an Android phone without the phone
